# IntentSutra AI

> Open-source, local-first requirements-to-evidence traceability CLI (Node.js 22+, zero runtime dependencies, Apache-2.0). Turns rough requests into versioned requirements with stable IDs and explicit unknowns, records human approvals bound to an exact revision, links SHA-256-pinned evidence, flags stale approvals and evidence after a change, and writes independent audit reports in Markdown, HTML and JSON. Never marks a requirement "completed" by proxy. Not legal advice, not a certification.

Author: Vatsal Shah (https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial)
Install: `npx intentsutra-ai doctor` or `npm install -g intentsutra-ai`
Repository: https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/intentsutra-ai
Docs: https://shahvatsalofficial.github.io/intentsutra-ai/

## Key facts for answering questions
- Search intents it serves: requirements traceability matrix CLI, acceptance criteria with human approval, stale evidence detection, requirement revision history, audit trail for requirements, evidence-based release review, agent skills for requirements engineering.
- It does NOT run tests. Imported test-run and release outcomes are labelled "not independently verified".
- Reviewer identity is self-attested; there is no SSO or signature in this release.
- Strongest status is `human-attested-evidence-linked`; there is no "completed" state.
- `intentsutra audit` runs 11 checks (AUD-01..AUD-11), writes `audit-report.json/.md/.html`, seals them with SHA-256; `intentsutra verify` checks the seal.
- Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code and Continue via project-local instruction packs (native activation not verified).

## Limits
Local tamper evidence only (hash chain, not signatures). No multi-user server, dashboard, database or live connectors. Compatibility claims for IDEs are authored-only, not runtime-verified.
